_comment: FAKE identity for development only. Replace with your own SSOT — never commit real data. PII is kept out of this file: it lives in the Dify app env var PII_JSON (see examples/pii.example.json). If identity.pii is present anyway, the workflow strips it before the LLM sees the profile as a fallback.
